entry.title: Conwy Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Two overhead pictures confirm eight open round towers, paired roofless wards and the bent south hall. Standard viewer PMTiles and the cached exact castle outline set placement and east-west orientation. Court3.5m above the working sample clears the coarse rock surface; western town entry and eastern river barbican remain approximate. Anchor -3.82555084,53.280022417; heading 0.07442147105; standard PMTiles datum 8.781932169860132m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
